correctness.rationale: An exhaustive 132-permutation generator agrees with an independent Catalan recursion for lengths 1–6; the complete 132-vertex compatibility-graph branch-and-bound uses a valid proper-coloring upper bound and returns maximum clique size 13. An explicit thirteen-word code has disjoint standardized deletion shadows. Integral output covers certify equality for smaller lengths. For length six, two exact nonnegative integer LP certificates scaled by 308 satisfy all 42 primal and 132 dual inequalities with matching totals 4434. A replay of delivered standalone files returned VERIFY_OK; no finite check is extrapolated to an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The sharp first integrality and rounding failure for a natural deletion-shadow packing relaxation in a Catalan pattern-avoidance language is a motivated numerical/structural boundary, not an arbitrary slice. Exact capacity 13 versus LP 2217/154 shows that even rounding down the standard fractional bound overstates achievable one-trace code size. The finite certificate provides a reusable benchmark for constrained-source rank-channel coding and studies a different invariant than prior entire-deck reconstruction.
